legendplot: Standard and ‘rgl’ Plots with Legends

This package provides tools to combine standard R plots or ‘rgl’ 3D plots with a legend, facilitating the creation of composite figures that mix 2D or 3D visualizations with a categorical or continuous legend.

For more information visit https://rubenfcasal.github.io/legendplot/articles/legendplot.html.

Installation

legendplot is not yet available from CRAN, but you can install the development version from github with:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("rubenfcasal/legendplot")
